newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets up panel to review mining rules.
newsitem.headline: India sets up panel to review mining rules.

text.p: The Indian government has set up a committee to review the existing rules and procedures for mining, a Mines Ministry statement said on Monday.

The committee will study current laws and procedures relating to regulation and development of minerals and suggest steps to reduce delays in the grant and renewal of prospecting licences and mining leases.
The statement said the committee will also consider delegating more powers to state governments on the granting and renewal of licences and leases, and measures to check illegal mining.
